tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: [GET /v1/search — $0.02] Search Spanish public-sector IT/software/cyber procurement: awards, tenders and contracts. Filters: q (full-text), cpv (prefix), buyer, company, region (NUTS), from/to (YYYY-MM-DD), type=award|tender|contract. Returns compact rows with ids for the other tools.

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: [GET /v1/tenders/:id — $0.02] Full tender detail by id: buyer, CPVs, deadline, estimated value, all awards/lots with winners, plus provenance (source + TED url).

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: [GET /v1/companies/:id — $0.05] Company profile by id: name, country, NIF, aliases and source identifiers (cross-source identity), plus aggregate stats (wins, total awarded value, top CPVs, top buyers).

tools.name: get_company_awards
tools.description: [GET /v1/companies/:id/awards — $0.05] Paginated award history for a company: dates, lots, values, tender + buyer context.

tools.name: get_company_opportunities
tools.description: [GET /v1/companies/:id/opportunities — $0.10] Active/recent tenders matching a company's historical CPV/buyer profile, with a deterministic similarity score (explained in score_explanation).

tools.name: get_buyer_history
tools.description: [GET /v1/buyers/:id/history — $0.05] Buyer profile by id: award history, supplier concentration (top-supplier share) and per-CPV-division recurrence (median months between awards).

tools.name: get_renewals
tools.description: [GET /v1/renewals — $0.25] Forecast signals for likely re-tenders: contracts/frameworks approaching renewal. Filters: cpv (prefix), buyer, window_months (default 12, max 36), min_confidence=low|medium|high.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: [GET /v1/pricing — $0.00] Machine-readable price ladder for all endpoints/tools plus the payment flow. Always free.

tools.name: research
tools.description: [POST /v1/research — $0.50] High-level EU public procurement intelligence for a topic: recent tenders, relevant renewal signals, company opportunities and active buyers, each with evidence and an evidence-strength confidence label. Deterministic over the licita database (no LLM). Costs $0.50 USDC pe

tools.name: billing_get_balance
tools.description: [GET /v1/billing — $0.00] Check the prepaid credit balance for a client key (in cents and USD). Always free. Returns not_found when no account exists yet — buy credits via billing_purchase_credits to create one.

tools.name: billing_purchase_credits
tools.description: [POST /v1/billing/credits/5 — $5.00] Buy a prepaid credit bundle (5, 10 or 25 USD) paid per-endpoint via x402 (mirrors REST POST /v1/billing/credits/:amount). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tender · Private data: research · Public sink: get_buyer_history, research, billing_purchase_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tender · Private data: research · Public sink: get_buyer_history, research, billing_purchase_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
